ProjectMetadata.Name: UBB-SE-2026-925-1
ProjectMetadata.Description: Original standalone repository created by Team 925/1 before consolidation into the unified MovieApp project.
ProjectMetadata.ArchitectureType: Traditional MVVM Layout (Views/ViewModels/Services) for UI, Clean Architecture (Core, Infrastructure, Web, WebAPI, Proxy)

Rule.name: Spaces for indentation
Rule.Description: Uses spaces for indentation (generally 4 spaces wide).

Rule.name: Line Endings
Rule.Description: Uses Windows-style CRLF line endings in C# files.

Rule.name: Namespace declarations
Rule.Description: Uses C# 10 file-scoped namespace declarations (e.g. 'namespace MovieApp.Core.Services;') instead of block-scoped braces namespaces.

Rule.name: Type member qualification
Rule.Description: Local member variables, fields, and repository calls are qualified with 'this.' (e.g., 'this.badgeRepository.GetAllAsync()').

Rule.name: Private fields naming
Rule.Description: Private backing fields carry the '_' prefix (e.g. 'private readonly IUserBadgeRepository _userBadgeRepository;').

Rule.name: var keyword usage
Rule.Description: Heavily utilizes the 'var' keyword in method bodies for local variable declarations (similar to current codebase).

Rule.name: Explicit access modifiers
Rule.Description: Most members are declared with explicit modifiers, but without StyleCop/editorconfig constraints, there is no automatic enforcement.

Rule.name: Braces layout
Rule.Description: Uses opening braces on new lines (Allman style) for class and method declarations.

Project.name: MovieApp.UI
Project.Description: Desktop client application. Structured using a traditional MVVM folder layout rather than a feature-based structure.

File.description: Movie detail, screening schedule, and checkout screen.
List of events the user has booked tickets for.
User profile, stats, and achievements display.
Referral code generation, sharing, and validation.
Gamification feature: spin slot machine for balance/points.
Gamification feature: trivia questions for rewards.

Folder.name: ViewModels
Folder.description: Contains corresponding ViewModel logic classes for the Views.

Folder.name: Events
Folder.description: Contains event and booking view models (e.g. DetailsCheckoutViewModel.cs, SeatGuideViewModel.cs, EventManagementViewModel.cs).

Folder.name: Services
Folder.description: UI services (e.g., local dialog management, navigation service).

File.description: DI configuration registering views, viewmodels, and services.

Project.name: MovieApp.Core
Project.Description: Contains core domain models, service interfaces, DTOs, and core business services.

Folder.name: Models
Folder.description: Domain entities representing data structures (e.g., Movie, User, Bet, Seat, SeatBooking, SlotMachineResult, WatchedEvent, ReferralLog). Includes 925-specific seat booking models.

Folder.name: Services
Folder.description: Business logic service implementations (e.g. BattleService.cs, BadgeService.cs, MarathonService.cs, SlotMachineService.cs).

Folder.name: DTOs
Folder.description: Data transfer objects for controllers and services.

Project.name: MovieApp.Infrastructure
Project.Description: Implements repositories and contains the database context class.

Folder.name: Repositories
Folder.description: Contains 22 repository classes implementing interfaces defined in Core (e.g. BattleRepository.cs, TriviaRepository.cs, UserSlotMachineStateRepository.cs).

Project.name: MovieApp.Proxy
Project.Description: API proxies prefixed with 'Remote' that access the REST API backend (e.g. RemoteBadgeService.cs, RemoteMarathonService.cs).

Folder.name: Controllers
Folder.description: Standard ASP.NET Core controllers (e.g. BattlesController.cs, EventsController.cs, SlotMachineController.cs, MarathonsController.cs).

Project.name: MovieApp.Web
Project.Description: Web frontend built on ASP.NET Core MVC.
